definitions.explanation: The act of gathering and broadcasting news to the public.

notes:
COMPOUND: {報|ほう} (report) + {道|どう} (way, convey)

VERB USAGE:
As a suru-verb, {報道|ほうどう}する takes the event or facts reported as its object, and the passive {報道|ほうどう}される is far more common in ordinary sentences than the active — Japanese news writing normally reports what "was reported" rather than naming the outlet as the subject.

REGISTER:
{報道|ほうどう} is a formal, institutional word. It refers to news put out by an organized outlet; you would not use it for personal news you pass on to a friend. For that, use ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧ or simply ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {報道|ほうどう}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧ (according to reports)
- {報道|ほうどう}⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧ (news organization)
- {報道|ほうどう}⟦{陣|じん}→陣：noentry⟧ (press corps)
- {報道|ほうどう}⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧ (news program)
- {報道|ほうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ (freedom of the press)
